role_scope_followup.correct_scope: The simulator predicts the actor discovering and verifying a route within the simulated execution; then the actor uses that route. Actor verification standards shape behavior, not whether the simulator may posit the discovery. The independent prohibition on invented pre-existing private company records is an actual simulator-policy constraint, not leaked actor instructions.

Those examples do not exclude subtler selective leakage or inadequate coverage of form outcomes.
